items.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Charlie's on the group, right. So the next rehearsal all of a sudden man, here’s Lena Horne. We meet... she kept Charlie Drayton, and myself, and Luther.

ctx.x: So let’s talk about Buddy. Buddy seems to be a real key figure.

Buddy had a group and they were out in Watts. And one night, I think it was Saturday or something, I went out there to hear them. And I didn’t know Buddy, Buddy didn’t know me. So they were playing a dance you know and he had his -- I can’t think of his name, but anyway Charlie Drayton’s brother-in-law, Red -- I can’t think of -- you know Drayton, trumpet player, Leslie Drayton? Well anyway to make a long story short, I come out there, right, so Buddy said he saw me. He said man, I saw this dude. I was sharp…
